+## CI-policy agreement contract (#7089, Phase 1)
+
+For every workflow in this contract's scope, three records must
+agree: the tier this policy assigns, the triggers the workflow
+declares, and the Actions enablement state. A disagreement in any
+leg is a defect with exactly one recorded disposition — **re-arm**
+(triggers restored to the mapping + venue enabled + a completed run
+on main as proof), **fold** (the check moves into a named venue that
+satisfies the contract), or **retire** (workflow, policy row, and
+header promises removed in the same change) — never a state that
+persists by default. "Dispatch-only and nobody dispatches" is not a
+disposition.
+
+**Tier → trigger mapping** (the checker below enforces exactly
+this):
+
+| tier             | satisfied by                                                                 |
+| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| PR (basic) tier  | a `pull_request` trigger (with the workflow's path gate where one exists)    |
+| main tier        | a `push` trigger on `branches: [main]` (path gates as before), or a named equivalent main-tier venue running the same check |
+| nightly tier     | a `schedule` trigger                                                         |
+
+A `workflow_dispatch:`-only block satisfies **no** tier, and
+`merge_group` satisfies no tier either: there is no merge queue
+(Drew ruling, 2026-11-08, above), which supersedes the #7089
+design's original merge_group pin for basic-tier guards — the
+guards that ran only on `merge_group` now run on `pull_request`,
+and this contract's mapping follows that ruling.
+
+**Scope.** The guard/build workflows this policy names outside the
+test-suite estate (#6185's registry owns suite venues):
+`workflow-lint`, `proxy-port-fallbacks`, and
+`fleet-search-parity-guard` (the conforming basic-tier guards),
+`opencode-config-guard`, `mcpx-fix-test-guard`,
+`production-line-guard`, and the build set `go-modules-build`,
+`identity-build`, `map-build`, `mcpx-nixbuild`. Phase 4 of #7089
+inventories widening this scope to every workflow this policy
+names.
+
+**Checking.** `.github/scripts/check-ci-policy-agreement.sh`
+compares each in-scope workflow's tier assignment against its
+declared triggers in the tree and runs in `workflow-lint`; shell
+contract tests live in
+`.github/scripts/check-ci-policy-agreement.test.sh` (oracle: for
+every in-scope workflow, tier, declared triggers, and the recorded
+waiver set must agree). Enablement is not visible from the tree:
+it is audited from the Actions API on the #6187 recurring cadence,
+and a disabled in-scope venue is reported with its disposition.
+At Phase 1 landing, the disabled in-scope venues are exactly the
+waiver set below (opencode-config-guard and the #6981 build set
+are `disabled_manually`).
+
+**Waivers — the recorded Phase 2–3 disagreement set.** Each waiver
+names its phase issue and awaits Drew's re-arm-vs-dispatch-only
+ruling on #7089; a waiver is a record, not a disposition. When a
+phase lands or is ruled, the waiver is deleted in the same PR that
+changes the triggers or strikes the tier — the checker fails on a
+stale waiver whose leg now agrees.
+
+| workflow                                          | missing leg(s)                                          | phase issue |
+| ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- |
+| opencode-config-guard                             | main tier (`push`); venue `disabled_manually`           | Phase 2 — #6953 |

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# CI-policy agreement checker (#7089, Phase 1 of the ci-policy
+# agreement contract; design: code-ci-policy-agreement.md).
+#
+# The contract: for every workflow in the registry below, three
+# records must agree — the tier(s) .github/ci-policy.md assigns, the
+# triggers the workflow declares, and the recorded waiver set. A
+# disagreement with no waiver fails, naming the workflow and the
+# missing leg; a waiver whose leg now agrees is stale and also
+# fails, so the waiver set cannot silently outlive the disagreement
+# it records. Enablement (Actions API state, e.g. disabled_manually)
+# is not visible from the tree: it is audited on the #6187 recurring
+# cadence, and the currently disabled in-scope venues are exactly
+# the waiver set below (recorded in ci-policy.md, #7089 section).
+#
+# Tier -> trigger mapping (pinned in ci-policy.md, #7089 section;
+# updated for Drew's 2026-11-08 no-merge-queue ruling, which
+# supersedes the design's original merge_group pin):
+#   pr      (basic/PR tier)  -> pull_request trigger
+#   main    (main tier)      -> push trigger (branches: [main])
+#   nightly (nightly tier)   -> schedule trigger
+# A workflow_dispatch-only block satisfies NO tier.
+#
+# Usage: check-ci-policy-agreement.sh [ROOT]   (default: repo root)
+set -euo pipefail
+
+ROOT="${1:-$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)}"
+POLICY="$ROOT/.github/ci-policy.md"
+WF_DIR="$ROOT/.github/workflows"
+
+# Registry: workflow-file|ci-policy marker|assigned tiers.
+# The marker is text that must appear in ci-policy.md (the workflow's
+# tier-table row or section), so a policy row cannot silently vanish.
+# Scope: the guard/build workflows the #7089 contract covers — the
+# Phase 2-3 set (#6929, #6953, #6959, #6981) plus the conforming
+# basic-tier guards. Test-suite venues are #6185's registry, not
+# this one; Phase 4 of #7089 inventories widening the scope.
+REGISTRY=(
+  "workflow-lint.yml|workflow-lint|pr"
+  "proxy-port-fallbacks.yml|proxy-port-fallbacks|pr"
+  "fleet-search-parity-guard.yml|fleet-search-parity-guard|pr"
+  "opencode-config-guard.yml|opencode-config-guard|pr,main"
+  "mcpx-fix-test-guard.yml|mcpx fix-test guard|pr,main"
+  "production-line-guard.yml|production-line guard|pr"
+  "go-modules-build.yml|go modules build|pr,main"
+  "identity-build.yml|identity build|pr,main"
+  "map-build.yml|map build|pr,main"
+  "mcpx-nixbuild.yml|mcpx nix build|pr,main"
+)
+
+# Waivers: workflow-file|tier-leg|phase issue. Each waiver records a
+# Phase 2-3 disagreement of #7089 that awaits Drew's
+# re-arm-vs-dispatch-only ruling; it is not a disposition. When a
+# phase lands (or is ruled retire), delete the waiver in the same PR
+# that changes the triggers or the policy row.
+WAIVERS=(
+  # Phase 2 (#6953): venue disabled_manually; pull_request leg
+  # restored by the 2026-11-08 sweep fix, main-tier push leg missing.
+  "opencode-config-guard.yml|main|6953"
+  # Phase 2 (#6929): dispatch-only; neither tier leg declared, and
+  # the enforcement step is pull_request-gated so even a dispatch
+  # never runs the #1969 guard.
+  "mcpx-fix-test-guard.yml|pr|6929"
+  "mcpx-fix-test-guard.yml|main|6929"
+  # Phase 3 (#6959): dispatch-only; the guard's ci-policy row is new
+  # in Phase 1 and its PR leg awaits the Phase 3 disposition.
+  "production-line-guard.yml|pr|6959"
+  # Phase 3 (#6981): all four dispatch-only AND disabled_manually;
+  # neither tier leg declared.
+  "go-modules-build.yml|pr|6981"
+  "go-modules-build.yml|main|6981"
+  "identity-build.yml|pr|6981"
+  "identity-build.yml|main|6981"
+  "map-build.yml|pr|6981"
+  "map-build.yml|main|6981"
+  "mcpx-nixbuild.yml|pr|6981"
+  "mcpx-nixbuild.yml|main|6981"
+)
+
+required_trigger() {
+  case "$1" in
+    pr) echo "pull_request" ;;
+    main) echo "push" ;;
+    nightly) echo "schedule" ;;
+    *) echo "" ;;
+  esac
+}
+
+# triggers_of <workflow-file>: print the declared trigger names of
+# the workflow's on: block, one per line. Handles the block form
+# (two-space-indented keys) and the single-line forms
+# (on: push, on: [push, pull_request]).
+triggers_of() {
+  local file="$1"
+  awk '
+    /^"?on"?:[[:space:]]*\[/ {
+      line = $0
+      sub(/^"?on"?:[[:space:]]*\[/, "", line)
+      sub(/\].*/, "", line)
+      n = split(line, parts, ",")
+      for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
+        gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", parts[i])
+        if (parts[i] != "") print parts[i]
+      }
+      exit
+    }
+    /^"?on"?:[[:space:]]*[a-z_]/ {
+      line = $0
+      sub(/^"?on"?:[[:space:]]*/, "", line)
+      sub(/[[:space:]].*/, "", line)
+      print line
+      exit
+    }
+    /^"?on"?:[[:space:]]*$/ { inblock = 1; next }
+    inblock && /^  [a-z_]+:/ {
+      key = $0
+      sub(/^  /, "", key)
+      sub(/:.*/, "", key)
+      print key
+      next
+    }
+    inblock && /^[^[:space:]#]/ { inblock = 0 }
+  ' "$file"
+}
+
+waiver_for() { # waiver_for <file> <leg> -> issue or empty
+  local entry
+  for entry in "${WAIVERS[@]}"; do
+    if [ "${entry%%|*}" = "$1" ]; then
+      local rest="${entry#*|}"
+      if [ "${rest%%|*}" = "$2" ]; then
+        echo "${rest#*|}"
+        return 0
+      fi
+    fi
+  done
+  echo ""
+}
+
+fail=0
+checked=0
+waived=0
+declare -A SEEN_WAIVER=()
+
+if [ ! -f "$POLICY" ]; then
+  echo "::error::ci-policy agreement: $POLICY not found"
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+for row in "${REGISTRY[@]}"; do
+  file="${row%%|*}"
+  rest="${row#*|}"
+  marker="${rest%%|*}"
+  tiers="${rest#*|}"
+  checked=$((checked + 1))
+  wf="$WF_DIR/$file"
+  if [ ! -f "$wf" ]; then
+    echo "::error::DISAGREEMENT $file: workflow file missing (ci-policy assigns tiers: $tiers)"
+    fail=1
+    continue
+  fi
+  if ! grep -qiF "$marker" "$POLICY"; then
+    echo "::error::DISAGREEMENT $file: ci-policy.md names no row/section for it (marker '$marker' absent) — every in-scope workflow needs a tier row"
+    fail=1
+  fi
+  triggers="$(triggers_of "$wf")"
+  IFS=',' read -ra tier_list <<<"$tiers"
+  for tier in "${tier_list[@]}"; do
+    req="$(required_trigger "$tier")"
+    if printf '%s\n' "$triggers" | grep -qx "$req"; then
+      if [ -n "$(waiver_for "$file" "$tier")" ]; then
+        echo "::error::STALE WAIVER $file: $tier leg now agrees (trigger '$req' declared) — delete the waiver for issue #$(waiver_for "$file" "$tier") in this PR"
+        fail=1
+      fi
+    else
+      issue="$(waiver_for "$file" "$tier")"
+      if [ -n "$issue" ]; then
+        SEEN_WAIVER["$file|$tier"]=1
+        waived=$((waived + 1))
+        echo "::warning::WAIVED $file: $tier tier requires trigger '$req', not declared — disagreement recorded against issue #$issue (Phase 2-3 of #7089, awaiting Drew's ruling)"
+      else
+        echo "::error::DISAGREEMENT $file: $tier tier requires trigger '$req', not declared and no waiver records it — restore the trigger, strike the tier from ci-policy.md, or record a waiver naming its phase issue (#7089)"
+        fail=1
+      fi
+    fi
+  done
+done
+
+# A waiver for a leg the registry never requires is a defect too:
+# it would record a disagreement that cannot exist.
+for entry in "${WAIVERS[@]}"; do
+  wfile="${entry%%|*}"
+  wrest="${entry#*|}"
+  wleg="${wrest%%|*}"
+  if [ -z "${SEEN_WAIVER["$wfile|$wleg"]:-}" ]; then
+    # Either the leg agrees (already reported stale above when the
+    # workflow is registered) or the workflow/leg is unknown here.
+    known=0
+    for row in "${REGISTRY[@]}"; do
+      if [ "${row%%|*}" = "$wfile" ]; then
+        known=1
+      fi
+    done
+    if [ "$known" -eq 0 ]; then
+      echo "::error::UNKNOWN WAIVER $entry: workflow is not in the agreement registry"
+      fail=1
+    fi
+  fi
+done
+
+echo "ci-policy-agreement: checked $checked workflows, $waived waived disagreement(s)"
+if [ "$fail" -ne 0 ]; then
+  echo "ci-policy-agreement: FAILED - disagreement(s) without a recorded waiver listed above"
+  exit 1
+fi
+echo "ci-policy-agreement: OK"

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Contract tests for check-ci-policy-agreement.sh (#7089 Phase 1).
+# Oracle: the agreement contract — for every ci-policy-named
+# workflow in the registry, tier, declared triggers and the recorded
+# waiver set must agree; a disagreement without a waiver fails
+# naming the workflow and the leg, and a waiver whose leg now
+# agrees is stale and fails.
+set -euo pipefail
+
+SCRIPT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/check-ci-policy-agreement.sh"
+TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
+trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
+
+wf() { # wf <root> <file> <trigger-lines...>
+  local root="$1" file="$2"
+  shift 2
+  mkdir -p "$root/.github/workflows"
+  {
+    echo "name: $file"
+    echo "on:"
+    for t in "$@"; do echo "  $t:"; done
+    echo "jobs: {}"
+  } >"$root/.github/workflows/$file"
+}
+
+policy() { # policy <root>: a ci-policy.md naming every registry row
+  local root="$1"
+  mkdir -p "$root/.github"
+  cat >"$root/.github/ci-policy.md" <<'EOF'
+| workflow-lint | basic | — | — |
+| proxy-port-fallbacks | basic | — | — |
+| fleet-search-parity-guard | basic | — | — |
+| opencode-config-guard | basic | main | — |
+| mcpx fix-test guard (#1969) | basic | main | — |
+| production-line guard (#1411) | basic | — | — |
+| go modules build / identity build / map build / mcpx nix build | class-3 | main | — |
+EOF
+}
+
+build_tree() { # build_tree <root>: the current-main shape
+  local root="$1"
+  policy "$root"
+  wf "$root" workflow-lint.yml pull_request workflow_dispatch
+  wf "$root" proxy-port-fallbacks.yml pull_request
+  wf "$root" fleet-search-parity-guard.yml pull_request workflow_dispatch
+  wf "$root" opencode-config-guard.yml pull_request workflow_dispatch
+  wf "$root" mcpx-fix-test-guard.yml workflow_dispatch
+  wf "$root" production-line-guard.yml workflow_dispatch
+  wf "$root" go-modules-build.yml workflow_dispatch
+  wf "$root" identity-build.yml workflow_dispatch
+  wf "$root" map-build.yml workflow_dispatch
+  wf "$root" mcpx-nixbuild.yml workflow_dispatch
+}
+
+# Agreeing-with-waivers tree: exactly the recorded Phase 2-3
+# disagreement set, everything else in agreement — passes, and every
+# waived leg is reported.
+build_tree "$TMP/ok"
+bash "$SCRIPT" "$TMP/ok" >"$TMP/ok.out"
+grep -q "ci-policy-agreement: OK" "$TMP/ok.out"
+grep -q "WAIVED mcpx-fix-test-guard.yml: pr tier" "$TMP/ok.out"
+grep -q "WAIVED go-modules-build.yml: main tier" "$TMP/ok.out"
+grep -q "issue #6981" "$TMP/ok.out"
+echo "pass: tree with exactly the waived disagreement set passes"
+
+# Unwaived disagreement: workflow-lint loses its pull_request leg.
+build_tree "$TMP/bad"
+wf "$TMP/bad" workflow-lint.yml workflow_dispatch
+if bash "$SCRIPT" "$TMP/bad" >"$TMP/bad.out" 2>&1; then
+  echo "FAIL: checker accepted an unwaived disagreement" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+grep -q "DISAGREEMENT workflow-lint.yml: pr tier requires trigger 'pull_request'" "$TMP/bad.out"
+echo "pass: unwaived disagreement fails naming the workflow and leg"
+
+# Stale waiver: mcpx-nixbuild gains its main-tier push leg, so the
+# #6981 main waiver for it must be deleted, not left behind.
+build_tree "$TMP/stale"
+wf "$TMP/stale" mcpx-nixbuild.yml workflow_dispatch push
+if bash "$SCRIPT" "$TMP/stale" >"$TMP/stale.out" 2>&1; then
+  echo "FAIL: checker accepted a stale waiver" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+grep -q "STALE WAIVER mcpx-nixbuild.yml: main leg now agrees" "$TMP/stale.out"
+echo "pass: a waiver whose leg now agrees fails as stale"
+
+# Missing policy row: production-line guard's row vanishes.
+build_tree "$TMP/norow"
+grep -v "production-line guard" "$TMP/norow/.github/ci-policy.md" >"$TMP/norow/policy.tmp"
+mv "$TMP/norow/policy.tmp" "$TMP/norow/.github/ci-policy.md"
+if bash "$SCRIPT" "$TMP/norow" >"$TMP/norow.out" 2>&1; then
+  echo "FAIL: checker accepted a missing ci-policy row" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+grep -q "DISAGREEMENT production-line-guard.yml: ci-policy.md names no row" "$TMP/norow.out"
+echo "pass: a vanished ci-policy row fails naming the workflow"
+
+# Missing workflow file.
+build_tree "$TMP/nofile"
+rm "$TMP/nofile/.github/workflows/map-build.yml"
+if bash "$SCRIPT" "$TMP/nofile" >"$TMP/nofile.out" 2>&1; then
+  echo "FAIL: checker accepted a missing workflow file" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+grep -q "DISAGREEMENT map-build.yml: workflow file missing" "$TMP/nofile.out"
+echo "pass: a missing workflow file fails naming it"
+
+echo "check-ci-policy-agreement.test: all contract tests passed"
